title: Maria's finger bones tested in Sri Lanka come back male and female

tellings.quote: Number three, UFO researcher Steve Mera told me that two different finger bones of one of the M types, Maria, were genetically tested in Sri Lanka.

plain: Two finger bones from Maria, one of the small three-fingered bodies from Peru that some call the M types, were genetically tested in Sri Lanka, and one is said to have come back male and the other female. Michels passes this on from the UFO researcher Steve Mera, who told him about the tests. If true, the mismatched results would raise questions about whether the body is a single being at all.
